metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected during resting state (8 minutes with alternating 63-second periods of eyes-open and eyes-closed) and four task conditions (words, faces, emotions, houses). Each task consisted of three blocks: practice, right-hand response block (80 stimuli), and left-hand response block (80 stimuli), with stimuli presented for 1 second followed by a 500-700ms fixation cross. Participants responded to target stimuli via spacebar press. Detailed trigger codes are provided for all experimental conditions and stimulus categories.
